title: Chandler Bridge Formation; a new Oligocene stratigraphic unit in the lower coastal plain of South Carolina
citation: Sanders, A.E., Weems, R.E., and Lemon, E.M., Jr., 1982, Chandler Bridge Formation; a new Oligocene stratigraphic unit in the lower coastal plain of South Carolina: U.S. Geological Survey Bulletin 1529-H [p. 105-124], map scale 1:364,661.
notes:
Pages 1-47 are the front matter of USGS Bulletin 1529-H and notes 1-6 (New York, Oregon, Alaska, Alabama/Georgia, Gulf Coastal Plain, Massachusetts). None concern the Chandler Bridge Formation or South Carolina; nothing extracted for this record.
Pages 48-89 are notes 7-11 of USGS Bulletin 1529-H (Massachusetts, Kentucky, Arizona, New York, Connecticut). None concern the Chandler Bridge Formation or South Carolina; nothing extracted for this record.
The PDF is the whole of USGS Bulletin 1529-H (17 notes). Only note 13 (Chandler Bridge Formation, PDF pages 115-134, bulletin p. H105-H124) belongs to this catalog record; pages 90-114 and 135-140 of this packet are other notes (Montana/South Dakota Cretaceous, Madison Limestone of Wyoming/Montana) and were read but not extracted. Table 3 (mineralogy/texture, page 125) and the photograph pages 122-123 are garbled in the text layer and were skipped. Measured-section rows give thicknesses, not depths; each row's thickness is in the description's note, and no top/bottom depths were computed. The text layer renders the digit 1 as 'I' in bed and zone numbers and the phi symbol as '0'. References: only those relevant to South Carolina geology or the unit's age were recorded; general paleontological references (European and Pacific cetaceans, time scales) were skipped.
Pages 141-158 are notes 15-17 of USGS Bulletin 1529-H. Note 17 (Goose Creek Limestone, Charleston area, p. H137-H148) is a separate paper with its own catalog record (ngmdb:92728) and was not extracted under this record; notes 15-16 concern Virginia to New York. Nothing extracted for this record.
